text: Ops request for the Northgate water treatment plant: please flag anyone who hangs around the chlorine dosing building or the filter gallery fence for longer than the permitted five minutes, using the existing perimeter CCTV. Footage can be sent off-site to your cloud for analysis. Ordinary accuracy is fine here; a reasonable heads-up is all we need, not forensic-grade results.

hey, for the Elm St / Harbour Rd five-way junction study, can we get left, right and through movements tallied per approach off the pole cams? footage can't leave the roadside cabinet though, it has to be crunched right there. and the counts need to be really tight, signal-retiming-grade, no sloppy numbers please.

Under this schedule, the Provider shall continuously evaluate CO2 concentration readings, in ppm, from the NDIR sensors installed in each lecture theatre of the Hartley Building and use them to set the outside-air damper positions on the building's air handling units. Sensor data may be transmitted to and analysed at the Provider's off-premises facilities. Processing under this clause shall be treated as time-critical and take precedence over routine workloads.

ED Triage Assist: Bay 3 needs help immediately interpreting questions like 'where is the pain' and 'are you allergic to anything' between English and Tigrinya, Dari and Somali for arriving patients. Audio must be handled on the hospital's own server and never leave the building. Rough but usable translations are acceptable; speed matters more than polish.

Hey assistant, before we haul the sledges up to the plateau camp tomorrow, process today's towed ground-penetrating radar traces and profile the buried snow bridges along our route, giving me bridge thickness and the depth to the void underneath. Any off-site server can do the crunching. Make it as precise as possible and do it right now, please.

Hi Priya, the harbour pilots have asked for sea-state figures from the three wave buoys moored off the breakwater: significant wave height (Hs) and peak swell period, derived from each buoy's heave accelerometer records. Please note the raw buoy data has to be processed on the harbour master's own shore station and can't be shipped to any outside cloud. Thanks, Tom

Request from the cruise ship hotel desk: the in-cabin concierge speakers need to catch the moment a guest says 'Hey Marina' amid the constant room audio so the assistant can wake up. Audio snippets may be handled on shore-side servers rather than aboard. Reasonable accuracy is enough; an occasional miss is tolerable.

yo, the triaxial accelerometers on the suspension bridge deck have been showing weird sway since this morning's gale... can someone pull the vibration spectrum and check whether the main span is sitting near one of its resonant modes? fine to process it offsite, basic accuracy is plenty, but please jump on it asap.

The Contractor's monitoring service shall log the working cycles of each excavator, dump truck and tower crane on the Westgate interchange widening project, distinguishing active digging, hauling and lifting from periods in which engines sit idle. Measurement accuracy consistent with ordinary site reporting shall be deemed acceptable. Given the Contractor's exposure to liquidated damages, this work shall be processed on an expedited basis ahead of other queued analytics.

Gateway notice: soil-moisture probes in the back paddock are pushing bloated JSON readings that blow our LoRaWAN airtime budget. Please re-encode each reading into compact protobuf binary against our .proto schema with lossless, byte-exact fidelity. No rush on this one; it can wait in the regular queue.

Hey Nova, scan the last hour of telemetry strips for patients on the cardiac step-down ward and tell me if anyone's showing runs of V-tach or A-fib, and I need clinical-grade accuracy on that, no guessing.

Hi team, the metro station CCTV archive is about to hit its storage cap by Friday. Could you pull just the I-frames out of the platform and concourse recordings so we keep a thin visual record and can drop the rest of the footage? Nothing fancy is needed on quality, but please prioritise this ahead of other jobs, since we're days away from overwriting evidence. Cheers, Dana

Lifeguard HQ, North Beach: please turn the photodiode UV readings from the tower-mounted sensors into a UV index value we can post on the beach flags board. Processing on your remote servers is fine. Figures need to be precise and well calibrated, because the council publishes them as public sun-safety advice.

hey, Saturday rush is killing us at the Parramatta supermarket, trolleys jammed up by the produce and bakery aisles again. can the ceiling cams show where shoppers are bunching up along the main walkways? footage stays in-store, rough numbers are fine, but we need it running before lunch today.

The Service Provider shall interpret the sonic travel-time and amplitude logs recorded by the wireline tool in Well KB-12 to verify that the cement sheath bonding the production casing to the formation is continuous and free of channels. All log files shall remain on the wellsite data unit and shall not be transferred elsewhere. Interpretation shall meet the rigour expected of a certified petrophysical review. This work carries ordinary scheduling priority and is not time-critical.

Motorway overpass feed: please draw a box around every car, truck and motorbike in the top-down gantry camera frames, as accurately as you can make it, for the lane-occupancy study. Cloud-side processing is acceptable. Scheduling is the ordinary queue, nothing time-sensitive.

Hey Jarvis, keep an eye on the TLS certs for every HTTPS service on our clinic's internal network and warn me well before any of them lapse, checking from inside the building only with no outside lookups. Get the expiry dates exactly right, but it isn't pressing, next week is fine.

Hi Marco, operators at Riverbend pumping station noticed the north raw-water pump has started to whine above its usual drone. Could you run the contact-microphone recordings from the motor housing through a bearing-wear analysis and tell us whether the rolling elements are starting to degrade? The audio can go to your off-site analytics environment. Please treat this as a priority; we'd rather not wait for the weekly batch. Regards, Hana

Evidence room access at Eastbrook police station is backed up this morning: officers' thumbprints from the optical reader at the door need matching against our enrolled prints so they can log exhibits. Templates and scans cannot leave the station's own server. Everyday matching accuracy is fine, just please process these right away.

hey, at the repair bench we've got a pile of dead router boards, can you get the tool to read the reference designators and serial numbers printed on the silkscreen from the photos? happy for the pics to go up to the cloud, and ballpark accuracy is ok, we'll double-check anything odd.

The Provider shall analyse audio captured by microphones positioned among the truss tomato rows in Glasshouse 3 to characterise the wing-beat frequencies of bumblebees during buzz pollination, determining whether sonication behaviour is occurring throughout the crop. All recordings shall be retained and processed on the grower's premises and shall not be transmitted off-site.

Store audit alert, Terminal 2 duty-free: the fragrance and liquor gondolas photographed at opening need checking against this month's approved planogram, flagging facings in the wrong slot, missing SKUs and swapped brand blocks. Accuracy has to be top-tier because supplier rebates are paid on these compliance scores.

Hey Dentra, check Mrs. Alvarez's new bitewings for decay between the teeth and any dark areas at the root tips that look like an abscess, and bump her to the front of the queue since she's already in the chair.

Hi Liam, following last week's drone flight over the wheat trial plots, could you run the hyperspectral cubes through a red-edge absorption analysis to estimate leaf chlorophyll content and map where the canopy is showing nitrogen deficiency? A reasonable approximation is fine for this season's fertiliser planning, and there's no hurry; any time in the next couple of weeks works. Best, Sofia

Radiology PACS request: set up screening of non-contrast head CTs coming off the emergency department scanner so that studies showing a fresh intracranial bleed, whether subdural, epidural, subarachnoid or intraparenchymal, get flagged for the neuroradiologist.

ugh, the hailstorm claims are piling up. can we get the parser to pull the policy number, date of loss, what got damaged and the repairer's quote off each claim form? numbers have to be spot-on since finance reconciles them to the cent, and we need these done first thing, ahead of everything else.

The Provider shall quantify RF interference affecting each 802.11ax access point across the Exhibition Halls of the convention centre, distinguishing contention from neighbouring radios on the same channel from bleed-over on overlapping adjacent channels. Measurements shall be of the greatest precision achievable with calibrated spectrum instrumentation. Given the imminent trade fair, all analysis under this clause shall be expedited and processed ahead of routine tasks.

Hotline QA dashboard: recordings from last night's crisis-line calls are ready for voice stress scoring, meaning the micro-tremor and tightness markers in each speaker's voice. Audio may be sent to the cloud analytics service. This is routine review, so queue it alongside everything else.

Perimeter radar, pinpoint small unmanned aerial vehicles using bounding rectangles on upwards-pointing visual streams to supply our tactical intercept pipeline. Standard baseline accuracy is completely adequate for this initial target acquisition.

Hi Gavin, at the hospital's central sterile supply dock we keep finding short deliveries. Could the system check each supplier's packing slip against the matching purchase order, line by line, and flag any item or quantity that doesn't agree? The documents are commercially sensitive and must be processed on our own premises only. It isn't time-critical, so please fit it into the regular schedule. Thanks, Ruth

Central Station concourse: platform CCTV needs to raise an alarm on any suitcase, backpack or parcel left sitting without its owner near the ticket gates. Video must be processed within the station's own equipment room. A reasonable hit rate is fine, but please get this live immediately given today's security advisory.

hey, for the salmon pens out past the headland, can the system run the blowers so oxygen saturation in each pen stays in the comfy range, easing off aeration when dissolved O2 is already plenty? cloud-side processing works for us, loose control is good enough, and it can wait till whenever suits.

The Provider shall monitor every surveillance camera covering the casino gaming floor and cash cage and raise an alert wherever a lens is covered, thrown out of focus, sprayed with paint or other substances, or knocked or turned away from its assigned field of view. Alerts under this clause shall be classed as priority events and processed ahead of all non-critical analytics.

Aged-care wing alert: the fire exit beside the dementia garden was wedged ajar and left unlatched tonight. Please notify the security guard whenever any outside emergency door is kept propped like this. Door sensor and camera events may be processed on the vendor's cloud platform.

Hey Atlas, there's a contractor crew in the data centre lobby right now, scan their national ID cards and driver's licences and verify they're genuine before badges get printed. Keep every scan on the local security server, make the verification rock-solid, and do it immediately.

Hi Ana, members at the Seaview co-working space complain that video calls stutter whenever someone starts a big upload. Could you look at the uplink router's egress queues and find out whether packets are piling up in oversized buffers once the link saturates, and measure how much extra latency builds up? You're welcome to pull the router telemetry to your remote analysis box. Cheers, Ben

Woodwork room at Kingsford Secondary College: need sound levels logged around the table saws and thicknessers through each class so we can see teachers' and students' cumulative dB exposure against the 85 dB action limit. Put it in the ordinary queue, no deadline.

hey, the cams along the fence line on the Newell Hwy stretch near Parkes keep catching roos, emus and the odd escaped cow, can we get those picked out automatically so the road crew knows where the fence is failing? rough is fine, doesn't need to be super precise, and no hurry at all.

The Provider shall estimate, for patrons entering the cosmetics hall on the ground floor of the department store, aggregate counts by broad age band (under 25, 25 to 44, 45 to 64, and 65 and over) and by gender, without retaining any individual identity. All video shall be processed on in-store equipment and shall not leave the premises. This deliverable shall be scheduled with ordinary priority, and no expedited handling is required.

AR studio notice: the virtual sports-desk graphics for tonight's broadcast look pasted on. Please work out where the key light is coming from and the colour temperature of the set lighting from the studio cameras so the 3D elements shade and cast shadows correctly. Precision must be broadcast-grade, and we need it before the 6 pm rehearsal.

Hey Dock, once the refrigerated trailer's doors swing open, tally how many taped cardboard shipping boxes are stacked inside, and the count has to be exact since we sign the carrier's bill against it, but there's no hurry, the regular pace is fine.

Dear Chen, following the tug that strayed onto 16R last month, operations would like the airfield surface cameras to raise an alert whenever a vehicle without clearance, such as a baggage tractor, fuel truck or follow-me car, crosses a hold-short line onto a live runway. Imagery must stay on the airport's own servers in the tower equipment room. Middle-of-the-road accuracy will do, and this is a routine improvement rather than a rush item. Kind regards, Maria

Mine survey team request: the stereo rig on the inspection rover driving the decline at level 540 needs its full 6-DoF trajectory, position plus roll, pitch and yaw, reconstructed frame by frame from the video, since GPS is useless underground.

hey, got borescope shots of the first-stage blades on GT2 at the peaker plant, can we have them checked for spalling and pitting in the ceramic thermal coating? images can't leave the plant network, and whenever the queue gets to it is fine.

The Provider shall analyse the Pacific Motorway CCTV network to identify multi-vehicle collisions, broken-down vehicles halted in live lanes, and debris obstructing traffic. Video may be processed at the Provider's remote data centre. Detection performance shall meet the most exacting accuracy requirements of the transport authority. Processing shall follow ordinary scheduling, with no expedited handling required.

Hot lab alert, nuclear medicine: the wall-mounted Geiger-Muller probes near the F-18 dispensing hood need their counts turned into gamma and beta dose readings in µSv per hour. Readings must be precisely calibrated, and please process them immediately, as staff are waiting to re-enter.

Hey Harbor, take the forty-page ocean freight manifest from this morning's container vessel and turn its cargo tables into structured records we can load into the logistics system. It's fine to process in the cloud, every container number and weight must be exactly right, and it can wait its turn.

Dear Imaging Systems Support,

We need to compute Agatston calcification scores along the coronary arteries using our patient thoracic low-dose computed tomography volumes. To ensure full compliance with healthcare privacy regulations, all CT volume processing and score calculations must stay strictly on the local hospital server infrastructure without transferring off-site.

Customs brokerage desk, airport cargo terminal: pull the HS tariff codes and the declared customs values out of this morning's import entries so duty can be assessed. Documents can be processed on your cloud service. Reasonable accuracy is enough since a broker reviews everything, but we need them turned around right away before the flights clear.

hey, can we get something that models how much hydrogen sulfide the biofilm is producing in the old trunk sewer under Main Rd and predicts how fast the acid is eating away the concrete crown? council wants to know which sections to reline first.

The Provider shall combine the tracked walking paths of customers across the ground floor of the flagship bookstore into occupancy heatmaps showing dwell and circulation by floor zone. All video and derived trajectories shall be processed on in-store hardware and shall not be transferred beyond the premises. Trajectory aggregation shall achieve the most exacting accuracy the Provider can certify.

Festival ops: pole-camera frames of the main stage crowd are uploading now; please estimate how many people are packed into the arena at each snapshot for the post-event attendance report. Offsite cloud processing is fine, a figure within a few percent is good enough, and no need to expedite since the report is due next month.

Okay Otto, I'm snapping photos of the water and gas meters in the apartment block's basement, both the old spinning-dial ones and the digital displays, so pull the reading off each one for monthly billing. Sending them to a cloud server is fine, and it can go in with the rest of the batch whenever.

Hi Kenji, a batch of fluorocarbon O-rings for the hydraulic actuators on our regional aircraft line has just come off the compression moulds, and we need every seal checked for moulding flash, trapped air voids and tiny pinholes running around its circumference. The camera images may be processed on your remote servers. Inspection must meet aerospace-grade accuracy, and please put this at the front of your queue since assembly is waiting on these parts. Regards, Elena

Resus bay, trauma team: handheld ultrasound clips of the chest from the motorbike crash patient need checking for missing pleural sliding that would point to a collapsed lung. Clips must be analysed on the hospital's local server only. A screening-level read is acceptable, but process them straight away.

hey, for the gated townhouse estate on Ridgeview Dr, can the boom gate camera read plates on cars rolling up and check them against the residents' approved list before it lifts? plate data stays on the gatehouse box, nothing goes to the cloud, and it doesn't have to be perfect, the guard can wave through any misses.

The Provider shall record the number of occasions on which customers try on footwear in the running and basketball shoe department of the sporting goods store, counting each fitting from the moment the customer is seated until the shoe returns to its box or display. All processing shall occur on in-store devices, with no footage leaving the premises. Counts of ordinary retail-analytics accuracy are acceptable, and delivery shall follow the routine monthly reporting cycle without expedited handling.

Price audit alert, suburban supermarket: photos of the shelf-edge labels in the health and beauty aisles are ready; please read the unit price and SKU number printed on each tag. Images can be processed in the cloud. Readings must be exact, since mismatches with the POS system trigger pricing complaints to the regulator.

Hey Aria, log the LAeq levels from the kerbside noise monitor in the Glebe residential quiet zone through the night, keep all the recordings on the council's local unit rather than uploading them, and the report can come whenever it's convenient.

Hi Dr Patel, the fracture clinic would like the scaphoid views from every wrist X-ray series taken after a fall onto an outstretched hand reviewed for subtle, undisplaced fractures of the scaphoid waist and poles, which are easy to miss on a first read. Could you set that up in the clinic's imaging workflow? Many thanks, Alice
